items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: And then after that was over, he went on the road with this vaudeville act, you see, and I was with that.

ctx.x: In 22 or 23 then? Along in there.

I guess it was 23, around that. Around that time. I just went in the, I think it was a vaudeville house then. Yeah, I'm sure it was a vaudeville house. And I played that Academy of Music years after that in a vaudeville troupe. I was playing trumpet for Ken Whitmer's band. Bill, somebody from the Music Box Review, a dancer on the act. Bill... Bill Seaberry. Bill Seaberry. Bill Seaberry was a famous dancer in those days in Urban Berlin's Music Box Review. Oh yeah. And then after that was over, he went on the road…
Was the band on salary during that time that you had? Yeah, yeah, yeah.
